tables.title: Table 4. Loaded freight cars and tonnage moved by railroads, South Korea, April 1946-September 1947
tables.units: tonnage in metric tons (m/t); freight cars in number of cars
footnotes: a/ The 1946 figures are presently being revised as they reflect fiscal reporting whereas the 1947 figures are on an operational basis.
b/ Represents movement of freight cars carrying goods for import or export under Civilian Supply Program.
c/ Total and average of available figures.
tables.totals_check: F/Y total column sums (Apr 1946-Mar 1947): tonnage May-Mar 2,819,143 = printed, agree (average over 11 months 256,286 agrees); total cars 128,963 = printed, agree; U.S. military 22,730 agree; civilian supply 15,140 agree; Korean freight 90,263 agree. Row checks (components vs Total): Jan 1947 1,991+2,710+9,557 = 14,258 vs printed 14,188 (disagree by 70); Feb 1947 2,097+4,692+6,300 = 13,089 vs printed 13,169 (disagree by 80); Mar 1947 and Apr, Sep 1947 agree. Other rows not checked.
warnings: Row Jan 1947: components sum to 14,258, printed total 14,188.
Row Feb 1947: components sum to 13,089, printed total 13,169.
